summary: O-011 (R2-m1) is fixed in tests/bugs/SL-064-MutantCases.ps1. C-007 used to compare two listings of the shared %TEMP%\fsa-window-mutants folder. It now reads this run's own scratch copy from the run's output: the distinct fsa-window-mutants\<32-hex>\ names in its 'Restored ...' and '-> ...' lines. It checks that exactly one copy was named and that Test-Path on it is false. Get-Scratches and the listing are gone. C-007 passes (exit 0, 52 s) with a stand-in folder created in the shared folder 10 s into the run, which is the reviewer's reproduction. A red check shows the new logic still fails when the run's own copy is left behind or two copies are named. Nothing else was changed.

files.why: R2-m1 / O-011. C-007 no longer compares before/after listings of the shared scratch folder. It checks that this run named exactly one scratch copy in its output and that the copy is gone. Get-Scratches was removed. The header comment for C-007 now says so.

obligations.how: Test-C007 now collects the distinct GUIDs matching 'fsa-window-mutants\\([0-9a-f]{32})\\' in its own $lines and checks there is exactly one ('the run named one scratch copy'). It then checks Test-Path on $ScratchParent\<guid> is false ('the scratch copy was removed'). The before/after listing and Get-Scratches are gone. Re-ran the reviewer's reproduction with a stand-in folder created 10 s into C-007, still present when the run ended: every check ok, PASSED: C-007, exit 0. A red check of the same code fails 'the scratch copy was removed' when the named copy is left behind, and fails 'named one scratch copy' when two are named.

tests.note: Run with a thread job that created %TEMP%\fsa-window-mutants\sl064-build2-concurrent-run-stand-in 10 s in (the reviewer's reproduction); the stand-in was still there when the run ended. All checks ok, including 'the run named one scratch copy (82c20683...)' and 'the scratch copy was removed'. PASSED: C-007, exit 0 in 52 s. The stand-in was removed afterwards.

tests.command: Inline red check: Test-C007's new cleanup block, taken from the script's AST, run over synthetic lines naming a GUID folder that exists
tests.note: It failed as it should: 'FAIL the scratch copy was removed' when the named copy exists, and 'FAIL the run named one scratch copy' when two GUIDs are named. The temp folder was deleted afterwards. A first attempt at this command was refused by the engine's path guard before running, because of a Remove-Item on a string it misparsed. It was rewritten with [IO.Directory]::Delete.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/bugs/SL-064-MutantCases.ps1 -Case C-001 (and C-002..C-006 each)
tests.note: all six exit 0 after the edit, unaffected as expected

tests.command: powershell.exe / pwsh.exe Parser::ParseFile on tests/bugs/SL-064-MutantCases.ps1, plus a non-ASCII byte count
tests.note: 0 parse errors under both; 0 non-ASCII bytes. No scratch copies left under %TEMP%\fsa-window-mutants.
